# PAR sheet
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py from scripts/templates/par-sheet.md. Edit the template. -->

This sheet lists the exact figures of the three dives I have built. The script `scripts/generate_docs.py` reads every figure from `config/dives.json` and from the reports in `reports/`, so a figure here is the one the solver wrote. The config is version 0.3.0, with hash `C54855C2AF0D292FCF6AB9FC829B6EC92738071B8694FA8967050FF2E893FDC1`. Money is in bets, and one unit is a thousandth of a bet. The solver works in double precision, and I round the figures for printing only.

The RTP is the expected award of one round as a share of the bet, and the standard deviation is that of the award of one round, in bets. The hit frequency is the share of rounds that pay anything. Mean spins counts the spins in a round, and mean crates counts the crates on the final board. The Grand figure is one over the chance that the board fills, and the reachable maximum is the largest award that can happen, which is a full board of the biggest coin plus the Grand. The rules are in [game-design.md](game-design.md), and the maths behind the figures is in [math.md](math.md).

The simulated row is one run per dive with seed 1. It checks the engine against the exact rows, and it is not a figure of the game.

## Classic Dive

The clock starts at 3 breaths and goes back to 3 whenever a crate lands, and the coins come from the mixed table.

## Tank Dive
